apps.name: RXTikTok
apps.subtitle: The Most Awesome TikTok Tweak for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
RXTikTok v2.0.4

ADDED:
[NEW] Bypass Russia Ban 🇷🇺 2.0
(without VPN, Select “Belarus” region)
- Customizable Download Menu
(Hide/Reorder Options)
- Custom Photo Default Download Action
- Custom Video Default Download Action
- Quick Download Actions (Hold for Menu)
- Custom Share Panel (Native-Style Options)
(downloads, links, post information, playback)
- Opt-In RXTikTok .IPA Update Checker
(toggle in “Other Settings” to be notified)
- Auto-Fetch New Localization
(select a Language to pull latest translations)
- Manually Mark Stories as Seen
- Mark Stories as Viewed Locally
- Expanded Profile Information
(Region/Counts/Dates)
- Profile Background Support
- Call Confirmation
- Hide Call Button in Chats
- Hide Favorites Star in Chats
- Chat Streak Information
- Exact "Last Seen" Time
- Keep Deleted Messages
- Deleted Message Indicators
- Hold to Download Comment Photos
- Hold to Download Comment Sticker
- Download Live Photos from Comments
- Enhanced AD-Block Filtering
(Following/DMs/Profiles)
- Block Location Ads
- Block Movie Ads
- Block Specific TikTok Sounds
- Download Haptic Feedback

FIXED:
- Story Photo/Video Downloads
(Correct Media Detection, HD Private Videos)
- Download Button Disappearing
- Downloaded Sticker Playback Speed
- Clear Display Button Showing Incorrect State
- Custom Voice Note Uploading
- Mark Seen on Reply
- Group Chat Eye Button
(Crashes/Interaction)
- Always Open Safari
- 60s Auto Clear History
- Accurate Upload Region Flags

CHANGED:
- Automatic Custom Voice Notes
(Duration/Conversion/Uploading/Playback)
- Upload Region Flag
(Tappable Country Name)
- DM Filtering Moved to Filter Locations
- Simplified Profile Information Layout
- Reorganized Some Feature Positions
- Reorganized Some Settings Tabs
- Automatic Temp Downloaded File Cleanup

REMOVED:
- Pull to Camera
- Enable Small Emoji
- Bypass Media Limit
- Enable Pin Chat
- Add Folders to Inbox
- Comment Location Flags
- Transparent Comments
- Auto Unfold Long Comments
- Increase Comment Character Limit
(they were either fully broken, useless, or both)
